title: What’s With All These Outages?
author: Brian Barrett
text:
Microsoft, the FAA, Chase, United, the NSA, and Apple all went down within one week. Officials say none of the outages were cyberattacks, but the internet isn’t buying it. This week on Uncanny Valley, WIRED senior business editor Sophie Kleeman joins Brian Barrett and Leah Feiger to discuss what actually went wrong and why people jumped straight to blaming hackers and AI. Plus, Anthropic’s historic IPO at a reported $1.5 trillion, Nvidia’s first earnings report since Jensen Huang resigned, and the administration’s new rule to stop Chinese companies from renting AI chips just before Trump meets Xi.Articles mentioned in this episode:Anthropic’s Record-Breaking IPO Highlights the AI Giant’s Worst Enemy—ItselfFAA Grounds All US Flights Until Further NoticeThe Microsoft Outage Is a Warning for the WorldThe Bank Outage May Have Nothing to Do With Your BankHow to Tell If It’s a Cyberattack or Just an OutageInside Nvidia’s First Post-Jensen All-Hands: Pay Raises and More EquityEven His Own Officials Don’t Think Trump’s China Trip Will Lead to Progress on AIYou can follow Brian Barrett on Bluesky at @brbarrett, Sophie Kleeman on X/Twitter at @sophiekleeman, and Leah Feiger on Bluesky at @leahfeiger. Write to us at uncannyvalley@wired.com.How to ListenYou can always listen to this week's podcast through the audio player on this page, but if you want to subscribe for free to get every episode, here's how:Featured VideoWhat Jensen Huang Resigning Means for Nvidia and the AI WorldIf you're on an iPhone or iPad, open the app called Podcasts, or just tap this link.
